fields.description: How much of this person belongs to this position. A management judgement about where they mostly sit - NOT a claim about hours, and never to be shown as one. A person's weights add up to 100.
fields.label: Weight

fields.description: Whose absence this covers, when there is one. Blank for a vacant seat.
fields.label: Covering For

fields.description: Permanent is the person's real job and counts toward their 100. Acting, Interim and Additional Charge are cover carried ON TOP of it - the person keeps their own role and takes this as well, which is why they are not squeezed into the same 100.
fields.label: Assignment Type

fields.description: Exactly one per person. Where they appear by default and the line the rest of the product follows.
fields.label: Primary

fields.description: Blank means current. Set it rather than deleting the row - last year's chart still has to render. Cover that never ends is not cover, so a temporary assignment is warned about without one.
fields.label: To

fields.description: Required when this pushes somebody past the organisation's ceiling. A written reason is what makes the exception a decision rather than a drift.
fields.label: Why they may go over the cap

fields.description: A title without authority is a half-measure that makes cover useless. Tick this and the people under the covered seat have their leave and expense approvals routed to whoever is standing in - and routed back when the cover ends. What it changes is recorded below so it can be undone exactly.
fields.label: Give them the seat's approval authority

fields.description: Why this split exists. A reader six months later is usually asking why, not what.
fields.label: Reason
